name: Granola
description: Search and read your Granola meeting notes, summaries, and transcripts.

methods.label: Sign in with Granola
methods.whenToUse: Sign in with your own Granola account so agents can read the meetings you can see.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect your personal Granola account. Each person signs in separately; agents only see the meetings the signed-in person can access in Granola. Reading notes and transcripts is allowed by default. Folder changes, workspace switching, sign-out, and feedback start Off; turn them on under Permissions if you need them.
warnings: Granola meeting notes and transcripts can contain sensitive conversations. Agents act with the signed-in person's Granola access.
